note: pick_next(logits[1,265], prev_ids[1,n], temperature=0) as called by RecurCoder.generate: adapt_strength 2.5, adapt_decay 0.88, rep_penalty 1.0, adapt_window 64. trace[v] = sum over the last min(n,64) prefix positions i with token v of decay**(age), age = 0 for the newest token (computed in float32, accumulated in position order); adjusted = logits - strength*trace; next = argmax(adjusted) (lowest index on exact ties). `adjusted` is the reference's own local after all adjustments.
